#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class TaskB {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, istream& in, ostream& out) {
        int n;
        in >> n;
        in.ignore();
        string s;
        getline(in, s);
        s = s.substr(0, n) + "_";
        
        bool inPar = false;
        int wordsInside = 0;
        int maxOutside = 0;
        int pos = 0;
        
        while (pos < (int)s.length()) {
            int delim = nextDelimiter(s, pos);
            if (delim == (int)s.length()) {
                break;
            }
            
            int len = delim - pos;
            if (len > 0) {
                if (inPar) {
                    wordsInside++;
                } else if (len > maxOutside) {
                    maxOutside = len;
                }
            }
            
            char c = s[delim];
            if (c == '(') {
                inPar = true;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                inPar = false;
            }
            pos = delim + 1;
        }
        
        out << maxOutside << " " << wordsInside;
    }
    
private:
    static int nextDelimiter(const string& s, int from) {
        int best = (int)s.length();
        int idx = s.find('_', from);
        if (idx != string::npos) best = min(best, idx);
        idx = s.find('(', from);
        if (idx != string::npos) best = min(best, idx);
        idx = s.find(')', from);
        if (idx != string::npos) best = min(best, idx);
        return best;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    TaskB solver;
    solver.solve(1, cin, cout);
    
    return 0;
}
